new.text: 7.2.4.11.11 Rte_Rips_NotifyStartOfReception [SWS_Rte_05328] Definition of API function Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyStartOf Reception_<CGI> ⌈ Service Name Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyStartOfReception_<CGI> Syntax BufReq_ReturnType Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyStartOfReception_<CGI> ( CbkHandleIdType ComUserCbkHandleId, const PduInfoType* info, PduLengthType TpSduLength, PduLengthType* bufferSizePtr ) Service ID [hex] 0x010a Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Non Reentrant for same sn, otherwise Reentrant ComUserCbkHandleId Handle Id of the Com user callback invoking the API info Pointer to a PduInfoType structure containing the payload data (without protocol information) and payload length of the first frame or single frame of a transport protocol I-PDU reception, and the MetaData related to this PDU. If neither first/single frame data nor MetaData are available, this parameter is set to NULL_PTR. Parameters (in) TpSduLength Total length of the N-SDU to be received. Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) bufferSizePtr Available receive buffer in the receiving module. This parameter will be used to compute the Block Size (BS) in the transport protocol module. ▽ △ Return value BufReq_ReturnType BUFREQ_OK: Connection has been accepted. bufferSizePtr indicates the available receive buffer; reception is continued. If no buffer of the requested size is available, a receive buffer size of 0 shall be indicated by bufferSizePtr. BUFREQ_E_NOT_OK: Connection has been rejected; reception is aborted. bufferSizePtr remains unchanged. BUFREQ_E_OVFL: No buffer of the required length can be provided; reception is aborted. bufferSizePtr remains unchanged. Description Rte_Rips_NotifyStartOfReception will be called to notify the RTE Implementation Plug-In of the start of reception of an N-SDU for the LdCom signal used for the Data Communication Graph requiring transformation.This function is designed to be a plug-in proxy for the LdCom TP Rte_ LdComCbkStartOfReception callback. See requirement [SWS_Com_00691] for more details on the functionality of this callback. Available via Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>.h ⌋ [SWS_Rte_05329] Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00300, SRS_Rte_00301, SRS_Rte_00312, SRS_Rte_00317 ⌈The associated Local Software Cluster Communication Plug-In shall provide the Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyStartOfReception_<CGI> Service for each • dataElement instance in an AbstractProvidedPortPrototype of an Atomic Software Component • operation instance in a PortPrototype of an Atomic Software Compo- nent • trigger instance in an AbstractProvidedPortPrototype of an Atomic Software Component IF • for the related Communication Graph the RTE Implementation Plug-In support is enabled AND • a transformation is configured according to [SWS_Rte_08794]. AND • the Communication Graph references a ComIPdu which has its ComIPdu- Type parameter set to TP [SWS_COM_00919]. ⌋ [SWS_Rte_05330] Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00312 ⌈The RTE shall call all Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyStartOfReception_<CGI> Services from the Rte_COMCbkStartOfReception callback for Communication Graphs where • The communication graph references a ComIPdu which has its ComIPduDirec- tion parameter set to COM_RECEIVE [SWS_COM_00919] AND • for the related Communication Graph the RTE Implementation Plug-In support is enabled AND • a transformation is configured according to [SWS_Rte_08794]. ⌋ [SWS_Rte_05331] Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00312 ⌈When a call to an Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyStartOfReception_<CGI> API exists within an Rte_COMCbkStartOfReception callback, the RTE shall pass through the following IN parameters from the outer callback function context as pa- rameters to the Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyStartOfReception_<CGI> call: • info • TpSduLength The variables passed to the Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyStartOfReception_ <CGI> shall be unchanged from the parameters passed to the Rte_COM- CbkStartOfReception callback.⌋ [SWS_Rte_05332] Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00312 ⌈When a call to an Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyStartOfReception_<CGI> API exists within an Rte_COMCbkStartOfReception callback, the RTE shall pass through the following OUT parameters from the outer callback function context as pa- rameters to the Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyStartOfReception_<CGI> call: • bufferSizePtr ⌋ [SWS_Rte_05333] Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00312 ⌈When a call to an Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyStartOfReception_<CGI> API exists within an Rte_COMCbkStartOfReception callback, the RTE shall ensure that the return value from the Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyStartOfReception_ <CGI> call is returned unchanged from the Rte_COMCbkStartOfReception call- back. ⌋
